vulnerability.explanation: display_log always prints dp->operation with "%s" (fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s: %s", ... , dp->operation)) even when dp->operation is NULL. For example, display_cache_file can call display_log on open/read failure before any operation is set (display_init sets dp->operation to NULL and read_png sets it later). Passing a NULL to %s causes a crash in libc, yielding a NULL pointer dereference.
